value.title: Item-level treatment effects
value.rationale: Checks whether the index effect is driven by one item.
value.method: OLS of each index item on treatment, HC2 SEs
value.finding: All three items move in the pro-immigration direction; see table for magnitudes.

value.title: Robustness to attention-check failures
value.rationale: The PAP retained failures; this checks sensitivity.
value.method: H1 model re-estimated on respondents who passed the attention check
value.finding: The estimate is similar when attention-check failures are excluded.

value.title: Heterogeneity by ideology
value.rationale: Ideology was not a registered moderator but is closely related to party.
value.method: Separate ATEs by ideology level and a treatment x ideology interaction, HC2 SEs
value.finding: Effects are larger among liberals than conservatives.
